label: In the month before the Coronavirus outbreak in March, how many portions of fresh fruit and vegetables did you eat in a typical day - Covid wave 2 (age 74 years)
meta_rows: In the month before the Coronavirus outbreak in March, how many portions of fresh fruit and vegetables did you eat in a typical day - Covid wave 2 (age 74 years)

A portion of fruit could be a whole piece of fruit, like an apple or banana or 80g of fruit. A portion of veg is 3 heaped tablespoons of cooked vegetables or beans. Questions about smoking, drinking alcohol, exercise, diet and sleep. Very slight difference in the wording of the question when compared to wave 1.
